name: gitlab-mcp
description: Adds zereight/gitlab-mcp for GitLab project, repository, issue, merge request, and pipeline workflows on gitlab.com or a self-managed instance. GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE is modify: create and update tools are on, delete tools are off; set it to readonly or full to change that. From 2026.10.25 it replaces the archived reference GitLab server and reads the same GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN and GITLAB_API_URL.
